description: City of Pittsburgh Signalized Intersections is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Pittsburgh. Signalized intersections operated and maintained by the City of Pittsburgh's Department of Public Works. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher City of Pittsburgh. Its tags are _etl, intersection, lights, signals, traffic. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, TXT. The portal shows 2024-06-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
